what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Morocco, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters rose from 336 in 2020 to 87020 in 2023.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Morocco list floods.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Morocco in these years.

when.text: The count fell to 256 by 2024; 2023 is the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 39 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Morocco.
